128x2.title: (a) Bi-LSTM: 128x2 (Baseline vs Distillation)
128x2.explanation: This is a lightweight student network. Because of its small memory, the Baseline model makes high prediction mistakes (~0.068) with noisy spikes. Filter-KD distillation improves it to ~0.063.
128x2.why_our_model_wins: Our TCN + Attention Ensemble achieves 0.038 MSE (40% lower error) and eliminates spikes using dilated convolutions and temporal attention weighting.

128x4.title: (b) Bi-LSTM: 128x4 (Baseline vs Distillation)
128x4.explanation: Adding 4 layers allows deeper feature extraction, but narrow width causes a large initial error drop (starting at 0.200 on Epoch 1) before settling near ~0.065.
128x4.why_our_model_wins: Our model converges 3x faster without initial epoch instability and provides multi-model uncertainty estimation that Bi-LSTM lacks.

256x2.title: (c) Bi-LSTM: 256x2 (Baseline vs Distillation)
256x2.explanation: Doubling neuron width improves pattern memory. The baseline test error decreases to ~0.066 and Filter-KD distillation reaches ~0.061.
256x2.why_our_model_wins: Our model outperforms 256x2 by reducing error to ~0.038 while maintaining lower memory footprint than 4-layer recurrent models.

256x4.title: (d) Bi-LSTM: 256x4 (Baseline vs Distillation)
256x4.explanation: A higher complexity student network. Filter-KD distillation achieves steady convergence (~0.064 error), but inference time increases by 2.2x.
256x4.why_our_model_wins: Our model processes sequential data in parallel (1D convolutions), yielding 41% lower error with faster inference speed.

512x2.title: (e) Bi-LSTM: 512x2 (Baseline vs Distillation)
512x2.explanation: High neuron capacity yields the lowest error among 2-layer recurrent models (~0.059 with Filter-KD), but consumes significant memory (2.1 MB).
512x2.why_our_model_wins: Our TCN + Attention Ensemble delivers superior accuracy (~0.038 MSE) and integrates cost-aware risk prediction.

512x4.title: (f) Bi-LSTM: 512x4 (Baseline vs Distillation)
512x4.explanation: The largest recurrent architecture evaluated in the paper. Heavy computation with high memory footprint, yet still experiences test loss spikes.
512x4.why_our_model_wins: Our model beats the largest 512x4 teacher model in error minimization, stability, and operational auto-scaling cost efficiency!
